# 全部机器能力（MCP 工具与 CLI 路由）

共 39 项能力。每一行都由主进程的操作注册表
（`src/helpers/appOperations/`）生成：同一份定义同时投影为 MCP 工具与
CLI 路由，因此两边的能力集合不再可能不一致。

策略含义：`read` 只读；`write` 可写；`destructive` 需显式确认
（CLI 需 `--yes`，MCP 客户端按 `destructiveHint` 确认）；
`needs UI` 表示该能力需要 SuperTing 窗口在前台运行（通过主↔渲染桥执行）。

## actions

### `actions.list` — List note actions

List the user's note actions (built-in and custom).

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`list_note_actions`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/actions`（CLI：`superting actions list`）

_No parameters._

### `actions.get` — Get note action

Get one note action definition.

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`get_note_action`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/actions/:id`（CLI：`superting actions get`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Action ID. |

### `actions.create` — Create note action

Create a custom note action.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`create_note_action`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/actions`（CLI：`superting actions create`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | 是 | Action name. |
| `description` | string | 否 | Short description. |
| `prompt` | string | 是 | Instruction sent to the model. |
| `icon` | string | 否 | Icon name. Default sparkles. |
| `output_target` | content\|enhanced_content | 否 | Where the result is written. Default content. |
| `write_mode` | overwrite\|append | 否 | How the result is written. Default overwrite. |

### `actions.update` — Update note action

Update a note action definition.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`update_note_action`
- CLI 路由：`PATCH /v1/actions/:id`（CLI：`superting actions update`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Action ID. |
| `name` | string | 否 |  |
| `description` | string | 否 |  |
| `prompt` | string | 否 |  |
| `icon` | string | 否 |  |
| `output_target` | content\|enhanced_content | 否 |  |
| `write_mode` | overwrite\|append | 否 |  |
| `sort_order` | number | 否 |  |

### `actions.delete` — Delete note action

Delete a note action definition.

- 策略：`destructive`
- MCP 工具：`delete_note_action`
- CLI 路由：`DELETE /v1/actions/:id`（CLI：`superting actions delete`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Action ID. |

### `actions.run` — Run a note action

Run a note action (for example 生成会议纪要) on a note. Requires the SuperTing window.

- 策略：`write · needs UI`
- MCP 工具：`run_note_action`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/actions/:id/run`（CLI：`superting actions run`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Action ID. |
| `note_id` | number | 是 | Note to run the action on. |

## dictionary

### `dictionary.list` — Get dictionary

Get custom dictionary hotwords.

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`get_dictionary`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/dictionary`（CLI：`superting dict list`）

_No parameters._

### `dictionary.set` — Replace dictionary

Replace the whole hotword list.

- 策略：`destructive`
- MCP 工具：`set_dictionary`
- CLI 路由：`PUT /v1/dictionary`（CLI：`superting dict replace`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `words` | array<string> | 是 | Full word list. |

### `dictionary.add_words` — Add dictionary words

Add hotwords, skipping ones already present (case-insensitive).

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`add_dictionary_words`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/dictionary/words`（CLI：`superting dict add`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `words` | array<string> | 是 | Words to add. |

### `dictionary.remove_words` — Remove dictionary words

Remove hotwords (case-insensitive).

- 策略：`destructive`
- MCP 工具：`remove_dictionary_words`
- CLI 路由：`DELETE /v1/dictionary/words`（CLI：`superting dict remove`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `words` | array<string> | 是 | Words to remove. |

### `dictionary.aliases.list` — Get dictionary aliases

Get replacement rules used by transcription correction.

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`get_dictionary_aliases`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/dictionary/aliases`（CLI：`superting alias list`）

_No parameters._

### `dictionary.aliases.set` — Replace dictionary aliases

Replace the whole replacement-rule list.

- 策略：`destructive`
- MCP 工具：`set_dictionary_aliases`
- CLI 路由：`PUT /v1/dictionary/aliases`（CLI：`superting alias replace`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aliases` | array<object> | 是 | Rules as [{"from": "...", "to": "..."}]. |

### `dictionary.aliases.add` — Add dictionary alias

Add or replace one replacement rule.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`add_dictionary_alias`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/dictionary/aliases`（CLI：`superting alias add`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | string | 是 | Misrecognised text. |
| `to` | string | 是 | Correct text. |

### `dictionary.aliases.remove` — Remove dictionary aliases

Remove replacement rules by their `from` value.

- 策略：`destructive`
- MCP 工具：`remove_dictionary_aliases`
- CLI 路由：`DELETE /v1/dictionary/aliases`（CLI：`superting alias remove`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | array<string> | 是 | `from` values. |

### `dictionary.groups.list` — List dictionary groups

List the dictionary group tree and item memberships.

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`list_dictionary_groups`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/dictionary/groups`（CLI：`superting dict groups list`）

_No parameters._

### `dictionary.groups.create` — Create dictionary group

Create a dictionary group (optionally nested).

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`create_dictionary_group`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/dictionary/groups`（CLI：`superting dict groups create`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | 是 | Group name. |
| `parent_id` | number | 否 | Parent group ID. |

### `dictionary.groups.rename` — Rename dictionary group

Rename a dictionary group.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`rename_dictionary_group`
- CLI 路由：`PATCH /v1/dictionary/groups/:id`（CLI：`superting dict groups rename`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Group ID. |
| `name` | string | 是 | New name. |

### `dictionary.groups.move` — Move dictionary group or item

Re-parent a group, or move a dictionary item into a group.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`move_dictionary_group`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/dictionary/groups/move`（CLI：`superting dict groups move`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `group_id` | number | 否 | Group to move. |
| `parent_id` | number | 否 | New parent group ID (null for root). |
| `item_type` | word\|alias | 否 | Move an item instead. |
| `key` | string | 否 | Item key when moving an item. |
| `item_group_id` | number | 否 | Target group for the item. |

### `dictionary.groups.delete` — Delete dictionary group

Delete a dictionary group; children and items are re-parented.

- 策略：`destructive`
- MCP 工具：`delete_dictionary_group`
- CLI 路由：`DELETE /v1/dictionary/groups/:id`（CLI：`superting dict groups delete`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Group ID. |

## notes

### `notes.list` — List notes

List local notes with previews and audio metadata.

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`list_notes`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/notes/list`（CLI：`superting notes list`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number | 否 | Maximum number of notes. Default 100. |
| `folder_id` | number | 否 | Restrict to one folder. |
| `note_type` | string | 否 | Restrict to one note type. |
| `tags` | array<string> | 否 | Require all of these tags. |

### `notes.search` — Search notes

Search notes by keyword, or by meaning when semantic is true.

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`search_notes`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/notes/search`（CLI：`superting notes search`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | 是 | Search query. |
| `limit` | number | 否 | Maximum number of results. Default 20. |
| `tags` | array<string> | 否 | Require all of these tags. |
| `semantic` | boolean | 否 | Use the hybrid keyword + vector index instead of keyword-only search. |

### `notes.get` — Get note

Get the full text fields for one note.

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`get_note`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/notes/:id`（CLI：`superting notes get`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Note ID. |

### `notes.create` — Create note

Create a local note and update the search index.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`create_note`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/notes/create`（CLI：`superting notes create`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | 否 | Note title. Default Untitled Note. |
| `content` | string | 否 | Note content. |
| `note_type` | string | 否 | Note type. Default personal. |
| `folder_id` | number | 否 | Optional folder ID. |
| `tags` | array<string> | 否 | Optional note tags. |

### `notes.update` — Update note

Update a note's title, content, enhanced content, transcript, folder or tags.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`update_note`
- CLI 路由：`PATCH /v1/notes/:id`（CLI：`superting notes update`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Note ID. |
| `title` | string | 否 |  |
| `content` | string | 否 |  |
| `enhanced_content` | string | 否 |  |
| `transcript` | string | 否 |  |
| `folder_id` | number | 否 |  |
| `tags` | array<string> | 否 |  |

### `notes.append` — Append to note

Append text to the end of a note's content.

- 策略：`write`
- MCP 工具：`append_note`
- CLI 路由：`POST /v1/notes/:id/append`（CLI：`superting notes append`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Note ID. |
| `text` | string | 是 | Text to append. |

### `notes.delete` — Delete note

Delete a note and its retained audio references.

- 策略：`destructive`
- MCP 工具：`delete_note`
- CLI 路由：`DELETE /v1/notes/:id`（CLI：`superting notes delete`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Note ID. |

### `notes.export` — Export note as text

Render a note to text without opening a save dialog (markdown, txt, json).

- 策略：`read`
- MCP 工具：`export_note`
- CLI 路由：`GET /v1/notes/:id/export`（CLI：`superting notes export`）

| 参数 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | 是 | Note ID. |
| `format` | md\|txt\|json | 否 | Export format. Default md. |
| `fields` | array<string> | 否 | Subset of: transcript, notes, enhanced. Default all present fields. |
